purpose: AI gate for source-grounded connected five-component Psychology learning packages.
decision: Generate and rewrite the connected package together; audit each available learning component independently; publish only components that individually pass their audit.
critical_failures: fabricated PYQ, researcher, experiment, statistic or citation
active recall answer not taught by the connected package
practice MCQ answer or explanation not supported by the connected package
content unrelated to the canonical micro-topic
cross-reference points to a nonexistent or self-referential micro-topic
cross-reference is unsupported or materially misleading
publish_rule: Audit each available component separately. A passing component is published directly to its static content pool; a failing component is withheld and queued for owner approval after two package-aware rewrite attempts. A failed component must not block unrelated components that pass.
